hymns.text: A prorocului Tău, Doamne, Sofonie pomenire prăznuind, printr-însul Te rugăm, mântuieşte sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Proroc Sofonie; the common of a prophet, with his name set into it

english.text: Keeping the memory of your prophet Zephaniah, O Lord, through him we entreat you: save our souls.
